ns2:course.label: Agr Cons and Resource Econ
ns2:course.description: Principles of microeconomics; demand, production, supply, elasticity, markets, and trade are presented and used in the analysis of decisions of individuals relating to agricultural production, food and textile consumption, and natural resource use. Macroeconomic concepts are also introduced. Students receiving credit for ECON 102 may not receive credit for ACE 100.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Students receiving credit for ECON 102 may not receive credit for ACE 100.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
